propositions: Structurally divergent provider/model responses can normalize to empty verification results that are incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes.

The verification kernel must distinguish between raw-empty (provider returns nothing), malformed-to-empty (provider returns garbage that reshapes to nothing), and unrecoverable (contract failure) responses via separate telemetry buckets.

Semantically empty verifications (no entry at a given finding index after chunking and reshaping) must never produce a valid pass or empty review; indeterminate outcome is already enforced by pass3_decide's no-verification rule.
Resilient parsing tolerates and repairs provider output variations while maintaining strict validation that recovered responses contain actual verification data, not empty structures.
Pipeline-level telemetry wiring to emit outcome_counts buckets from plan_review_decide and code_review_decide requires separate follow-up work independent of the kernel function implementation.
